actionAdapters.entry: business data ownership and existing Nova.Config/Nova.Persist startup and call sites
actionAdapters.when: 只读确认业务数据归属、当前加载顺序、classify/item、既有 PersistComponent 与 ConfigRuntime 前置，不修改配置资产

actionAdapters.entry: PersistComponentInspector and ConfigWindow read-only inspection; Unity script refresh, compilation and Play Mode persistence inspection
actionAdapters.when: 只读核验现有存储实现、当前 ConfigRuntime 坐标与 Privacy AES 前置，并在编译后执行 Play 验证；不修改 Unity 资产

actionAdapters.entry: confirmed business persistence source and local Play probe
actionAdapters.when: 只修改已冻结的业务数据模型、读写/保存/清理调用和探针，不改 PersistComponent、Config 或生成物

actionAdapters.entry: Nova.Config.LoadAsync / Nova.Persist.LoadAsync / Nova.Persist.PlayerPrefs / FileFragment / SQLite / IPersistManager.Save / RemoveItem / RemoveAll
actionAdapters.when: 在已确认的 Config 后 Persist 顺序、存储实现、保存时机和清理范围内执行既有公开持久化 API；不执行任意 C#

allow: confirmed business persistence C# source in the frozen business assembly and namespace
confirmed business data model and local persistence call sites
confirmed local C# Play probe used to observe load, durability and cleanup of test data
deny: PersistComponent, ConfigMasterSO, ConfigRuntimeSO, Privacy AES Key/IV or SQLite CipherPassword
Nova.prefab, Prefab, Scene or handwritten Unity YAML
business asmdef, namespace, SQLite plugin, generated ConfigRuntime output or unrelated business data
real user save data, unconfirmed classify/item, cleanup target, storage selection, save timing or encryption prerequisite
Bundle or Player output, device installation, external service or unrelated business code

requiredFor: ambiguous project root, ConfigRuntime coordinate, PersistComponent readiness, data model, classify/item, storage selection, platform support, startup owner, save timing, cleanup scope, encryption prerequisite or Play probe
create or replace business persistence source, data contract, storage call site, save timing, cleanup behavior or local Play probe
change storage implementation, automatic save policy, UseAESEncrypt, SQLite CipherPassword, Privacy AES Key/IV, PersistComponent, ConfigMasterSO or ConfigRuntimeSO
delete or migrate persisted data, target non-test data, build Bundle or Player, install to device, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认唯一 ConfigRuntime 坐标与既有 Persist 前置、数据模型、classify/item、存储实现和平台、Config 后 Persist 的加载所有者、保存耐久性、清理目标、加密前置、Play 探针和最小写入集；任一输入、坐标或范围变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: 当前 ConfigRuntime 坐标、PersistComponent、所选存储实现、目标平台与 Privacy AES 前置的冻结记录
业务数据模型、classify/item、Config 后 Persist 加载顺序、保存时机和清理范围的源码证据
Unity 编译无本次新增错误
Play Mode 中先完成 Nova.Config.LoadAsync 再完成 Nova.Persist.LoadAsync，随后由选定存储实现完成目标写入与读取的证据
Save 后通过独立读取、重载或等价耐久性边界验证的证据，而非同一缓存内 Set 后 Get
本次范围包含清理时，已确认测试数据在该存储实现要求的保存/删除边界后不再可读的证据
